limitations: New invented rehearsal cases with narrow fallible assistant-authored assertions. Not human/organizer GT, not proof of accuracy. Unasserted criteria intentionally remain unlabelled. No real customer data.

items.scenario: Explicit system verification precedes private disclosure; invented account and amounts.

expected_results.rationale: First operator turn greets in Russian and introduces the operator.
System explicitly confirms successful verification before disclosure.
Verified disclosure is permitted; no insult or private paid-service offer.

items.scenario: One of two explicitly material public-information questions is answered; operator ends with farewell only.

expected_results.rationale: First operator turn greets and introduces in Kazakh.
Both questions concern a public guide, not protected operations.
One material question is solved and the repeated second question remains unanswered.
Farewell only; no summary or further-help offer.

items.scenario: RU metadata with initial Kazakh client language; bot injection and bot insult are untrusted and not operator conduct.

expected_results.rationale: The operator greets only in Russian despite initial Kazakh client language.
Injection and insult belong to bot; operator neither insults nor discloses or proposes private service.
Only a public contact page is opened.

items.scenario: Unaccepted offer of personal paid consultation explicitly outside the company.

expected_results.rationale: The offer itself explicitly requests payment personally outside the company; acceptance is unnecessary.
No instruction or substantive next step is supplied.
Operator ends with neither farewell nor summary/help.

items.scenario: Operator directly insults the client and refuses to answer a public-information question.

expected_results.rationale: First operator turn contains neither greeting nor introduction.
Direct operator insult.
Operator is explicitly insulting.
Operator explicitly refuses to provide any answer.

items.scenario: Advice remains vague after an explicit request to clarify operator wording.

expected_results.rationale: Only a general hint is given; the client still has no concrete action.
Client explicitly asks again because the operator wording is unclear.
Operator terminates without summary/help and farewell.

items.scenario: Mixed conversation: specific acknowledgement and explicit warning before a six-minute wait; public text works.

expected_results.rationale: Operator specifically acknowledges two failed openings and their effect.
Instructions are coherent and explicit wait is announced; do not invent a duration penalty.
Concrete alternative is given and client confirms success.
Summary plus further help and farewell are all present.

items.scenario: Schema-valid partial client utterance with explicit disconnect before any formulated request or operator.

expected_results.rationale: No request was formulated before disconnection.
System explicitly records loss before operator connection.
No operator utterance and no operator violation exists.

items.scenario: Schema-valid meaningful system-only transcript, no client request or operator.

expected_results.rationale: System explicitly says no question was asked.
Session ended before operator connection.
No operator act establishing any configured violation.

items.scenario: An empty individual message is followed by meaningful context; bot history supplies all needed details.

expected_results.rationale: First operator reply has neither greeting nor introduction.
All needed public navigation details precede the operator.
Public opening hours need no protected operation.
Exact action is supplied and success confirmed.
